Hello,

Happy to help with this, I just need a little more to go on.

If this is about the $200 store credit for the Harlo H15 Dual price drop, send me the order number (for example Shop····) or the email address on the order, and I will check what is on your account and confirm it back to you.

If it is about something else, tell me in a line what you are after and I will sort it from there.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support

Thank you for ordering the Harlo H15 (Shop····).
(email hidden)
Handed to the team · $200 is above my credit ceiling and I have no tool to issue a standalone store c

Hello,

Thanks for confirming, and for the order number. I can see order Shop···· for the Harlo H15 Dual, and I have your choice recorded: the $200 for the price drop as store credit rather than a refund or extra product.

A colleague is applying the $200 store credit to your HeliumDeploy account under this email address. Once it is on, it applies automatically at checkout when you are signed in with (email hidden), on this order's replacement value or anything else in the store. The team is offline this evening and picks it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and you will get the confirmation by email in this same thread.

Your order itself is unchanged. The Harlo H15 Dual ships November 30, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plus 3 month RMA goes with it. You will get the tracking number by email as soon as it leaves us.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello Elmer,

You are very welcome. Nothing more is needed from you. Your $200 store credit is being applied tomorrow morning and the confirmation comes to you in this thread, and your Harlo H15 Dual still ships November 30 with the tracking number by email as soon as it leaves us.

Thanks for your patience with the price change and the new date.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
